title: Import from WordPress
intro: Upload a WordPress export file (Tools → Export → All content in WordPress). Posts, pages and custom post types become entries — check the summary first, then run the import in the background.
fileHint: A WXR .xml file, up to 50 MB. Nothing is imported until you start the import.
tooLarge: The file is larger than 50 MB
totals: {total, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} to import · {attachments, plural, one {# attachment} other {# attachments}} · {skipped} skipped
importMediaHint: Download attachments (images, PDF, MP4 up to 10 MB each) into the media library and point featured images and content at the new copies.
overwriteHint: Entries whose slug already exists are updated (the old version is kept in their history). Otherwise they are skipped.
run: Start import ({total, plural, one {# item} other {# items}})
